entities.title: Returning Resident Visa
entities.summary: A permanent resident who has remained outside the United States for longer than one year requires a new immigrant visa to enter the United States and resume permanent residence.
eligibility: Evidence of continuing, unbroken ties to the United States
Evidence that extended stay was beyond control
Evidence of intent to always return to the United States
required_documents: Permanent Resident Card (Form I-551 or green card)
Documentation of exact date of last departure from the United States
Proof of ties to the United States and intention to return
Proof that protracted stay outside of the United States was for reasons beyond control
application_process: Schedule an online appointment through Global Support Services (GSS) website
Attend an interview with a Consular Officer
entities.processing_time: varies depending on the particular circumstances of the case
important_notes: Re-entry permits can only be applied for when the individual is physically present in the United States
Approval of returning resident status does not guarantee the issuance of a visa
mandatory_prerequisites: Online appointment through Global Support Services (GSS) website
